item.description: Former India cricketer Mohammad Kaif has claimed that Australia would’ve lost the ICC World Cup 2023 final on November 19 against India had all-rounder Hardik Pandya played for the Men in Blue in Ahmedabad. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Cricket fraternity reacts as India continues winning run; defeats Netherlands by 17 runs in Ahmedabad
item.description: India ended their T20 World Cup 2026 Group A stage matches with a spotless record as they defeated the Netherlands in their final group game. Abhishek Sharma’s poor form continued as he got out for a duck thrice in a row. Ishan Kishan looked good but got out for 18 runs. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: “This is the situation I love to bat,” Shivam Dube elated after match-winning 66 vs Netherlands
item.description: Shivam Dube shone with both bat and ball as India defeated the Netherlands by 17 runs in their last T20 World Cup 2026 Group A clash at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad on Wednesday (February 18). item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: “Expectations might be weighing heavily on him,” Gavaskar advices struggling Abhishek to spend time at crease
item.description: India opener Abhishek Sharma, who was expected to set the T20 World Cup 2026 on fire, recorded three consecutive ducks in the group stage of the tournament. After starting the competition with a golden duck against the USA, Abhishek fell ill and missed the match against Namibia. The southpaw returned to the team for the Pakistan clash but was dismissed by Salman Ali Agha for a four-ball duck.
